stance_rationale: Primary 1M alpha fails rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey-NW, strict subperiod stability, and sector-neutral robustness gates. The draft is usable only as a rejected discovery archive after process gaps are fixed; it must not graduate to Risk/Optimizer.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260508_005/alpha_scores.parquet has 196 monthly Date_eom values, 184 with non-null alpha_z, 66,576 rows, consecutive ym monthly spacing, and no dates after 2026-05-08. The requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_005 path is absent.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Formula uses sign(expanding_IC_1..t-1) multiplied by beta_z and package marks explicit Z_Score_Aligned tag absent; PIT-safe timing does not remove the PIT-C13 sign-flip prohibition.
New macro-beta factor is not loaded from Factor DB; no Usable_Date path was used, and C2/C7 lag checks show beta_t-1 and expanding IC through t-1 only.
WT_005 directly reads inherited parquet artifacts; package itself says C15 is BYPASSED for raw ECOS+RAWDATA construction, with no infeasibility report.
No regime/DD overlay is applied; sign alignment uses expanding IC history through t-1 rather than same-month overlay state.
No financial-statement factor is used, so annual May / quarterly 45-day lag is not implicated.

critical_concerns.description: The primary 1M evidence fails graduation: rank_IC 0.0193 < 0.04, ICIR 0.183 < 0.20, Harvey-NW 2.14 < 3.0, and strict subperiod pass is only 1/3. Sign stability 3/3 is not a substitute for ICIR stability.

C13 is not clean: alpha construction uses dynamic sign(expanding_IC) alignment and the draft admits the Z_Score_Aligned tag is absent. Timing may be expanding/PIT, but C13 forbids manual sign flips as the alignment mechanism.

C15 is explicitly bypassed: WT_005 reads parquet artifacts and inherits raw ECOS/RAWDATA construction without load_month_factors() or an infeasibility report. This is a process bypass, not just a documentation gap.

RF-A4 is active: sector-neutral 1M IC drops to 0.0081 versus raw 0.0193, only 42% retention. Calling the raw signal sector-mediated does not prove alpha; it may be sector beta masquerading as stock selection.

Multiple-testing control is undercounted: method_shopping_log reports 17 candidates, but DSR n_trials uses 12 macro candidates and does not fully include smoothing variants, sector-neutral variant, or horizon exploration. The Harvey gate still has 0 passing specs.

The positive DSR is based on gross D10-D1 long-short deciles, while the mandate is long-only max-20 names. No weights.csv schedule exists, so implementable turnover, 15bps cost, and top-20 long-only degradation are unresolved.

No challenge_note.md, alpha_package.json, risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet exists for this WT, and the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260508_005 directory is absent. AX-008 triangulation cannot pass with only draft alpha artifacts.

supporting_arguments: RF-A7 is not triggered for the available Stage B alpha_scores.parquet: it is a multi-date Date_eom x Ticker panel, not a single snapshot.
The draft does self-report REJECT_GRADUATION and lists the major rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey, RF-A1, and RF-A4 failures rather than silently overriding them.
C2/C7 lag checks are directionally credible: beta_lag1 is used, expanding IC sign uses months 1..t-1, and no future sig_date appears in alpha_scores.parquet.
unresolved_disputes: Whether C13 can be waived for expanding sign alignment; base context says no unless formal Z_Score_Aligned compliance is produced.
Whether C15 bypass is acceptable for a new macro-beta factor; no infeasibility_report or challenge_note documents the exception.
Whether DSR should be recomputed on implementable long-only top-20 weights with 15bps cost instead of gross long-short deciles.
Whether WT_005 can rely on WT_004 universe-v2 inference; WT_005 did not rerun the v2 diagnostic despite weak ICIR.
Whether missing weights.csv and covariance.parquet mean Risk/Optimizer were never run or artifacts were misplaced.
weakest_assumption: That DSR, orthogonality, and 12M positives preserve a usable alpha candidate despite primary 1M gate failures, sector-neutral collapse, C13/C15 process gaps, and no implementable long-only schedule.
rebuttal_required: Produce challenge_note.md covering RF-A1 through RF-A7 and explicitly documenting C13/C15 exceptions or fixes.
Rebuild the alpha with formal Z_Score_Aligned compliance or prove why expanding sign alignment is not a prohibited sign flip under PIT-C13.
Rerun DSR, turnover, and cost on actual long-only max-20 weights.csv with 15bps one-way costs.
Run WT_005-specific universe-v2 and sector-neutral diagnostics instead of inheriting expected behavior from WT_004.
Provide or explicitly mark absent risk_package, optimization_package, covariance.parquet PSD/condition diagnostics, and artifact path reconciliation.
rationalization_red_flags: primary = raw because sector-neutral IC ~0.008 vs raw 0.019 = mostly sector-mediated tilt
v2 universe expansion not run for WT_005 ... single-factor expected similar pattern
Cross-section single-factor alpha is naturally orthogonal to time-series Hybrid

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Even though the draft self-rejects graduation, independent triangulation is incomplete: only alpha-side draft artifacts were found, with no risk/optimizer packages, weights schedule, covariance artifact, or challenge_note.

alpha_specific_questions: Can KR_TermSpread beta retain t_NW > 2.95 after removing the prohibited sign-alignment ambiguity and rerunning all 17+ tested specifications?
Does the alpha remain positive after sector-neutralization or is the raw IC only a sector allocation effect?
Can the gross long-short DSR survive conversion to the mandated long-only max-20 portfolio with 15bps one-way cost and turnover accounting?
